import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-data-sharing', templateUrl: './data-sharing.component.html', styleUrls: ['./data-sharing.component.scss'] }) export class DataSharingComponent { }

What is data sharing

sharing (or) Sending , variables (or) data from one component to another component is called "data sharing"

Types Of Data Sharing

Below are the two types of data sharing

  1. with parent-child components
  2. with different components
  3. with query string in url
  4. with routing configuration
